verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party MCP docs say it supports design generation, creating designs "from text descriptions and specifications," and design editing, applying "targeted modifications to existing designs through natural language commands." Separate docs also reference Canva AI designing with pasted-link context. Together these cover both halves of the story, generating and editing designs from prompts. Missing for 10: the evidence is only one-line feature bullets centred on the MCP/AI-assistant route, with no depth on layout or mockup quality and no independent or hands-on proof that the generated designs are usable.
